cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — lying on her front; a hangar maintenance bay — standing; a small late-night neighbourhood cinema foyer beside a softly glowing abstract film poster — waiting through the end credits outside the auditorium; a lit dance stage or milonga floor — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; a rooftop infinity pool with the city skyline behind it — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a sheltered tidal lagoon with a wooden bathing ladder and floating amber lamps at dusk — sitting at the dry ladder landing after a dip; a starship data archive — sitting on the ground; a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a desert oasis at golden hour — sitting on the ground; a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table — seated on a chair
